About.heroTitle: Dressing Brands for Success Since Day One
About.heroDescription: We started Pack Brand Solutions with one mission: give small businesses access to the same premium custom packaging that big brands use. Bilingual, fast, and affordable.
About.storyText1: Pack Brand Solutions was founded by entrepreneurs who understood the struggle: small restaurants, food trucks, and emerging brands deserved packaging that looked as good as their food tasted — but the big packaging companies only wanted to work with big brands.
About.storyText2: We changed that. Today we serve hundreds of businesses across the United States, offering premium custom cups, bags, boxes, food containers, and labels with low minimum orders, and bilingual support.
About.missionTitle: Your Logo. Your Brand. Your Identity.
About.missionText: Every cup, bag, and box we produce is a marketing opportunity for your business. We make sure your brand is front and center — from the first order to the thousandth.
About.ctaDescription: Join hundreds of brands who trust Pack Brand Solutions for their custom packaging. Let’s build your brand.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1Intro: We collect information that you provide directly when using our services:
Privacy.s1Item1: Name, email address, phone number, company name
Privacy.s1Item2: Shipping address, billing details, order history
Privacy.s1Item3: Messages sent through our contact form, email, or WhatsApp
Privacy.s1Item4: Logos, designs, and images you submit for custom printing
Privacy.s1Item5: Pages visited, features used, and interactions with our platform
Privacy.s2Item2: Communicate with you about your orders, products, and services
Privacy.s2Item3: Provide customer support in English and Spanish
Privacy.s2Item4: Improve our products, services, and website experience
Privacy.s3Body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with trusted third parties only as necessary to provide our services, including shipping carriers for order delivery, payment processors for secure transactions, and printing partners for custom product manufacturing. All partners are required to maintain the confidentiality and security of your information.
Privacy.s4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes encrypted data transmission (SSL/TLS), secure password storage, and regular security assessments. However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure.
Privacy.s5Body: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your preferences (such as language and theme), and analyze website traffic. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may limit certain features of our website.
Privacy.s6Item1: Access the personal information we hold about you
Privacy.s6Item3: Request deletion of your personal data
Privacy.s6Item4: Opt out of marketing communications at any time
Privacy.s6Item5: Request a copy of your data in a portable format
Privacy.s7Body: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. Order records are retained for a minimum of 7 years for accounting and tax purposes.
Privacy.s8Body: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.
Privacy.s9Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this page periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.
Privacy.s10Before: For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us at
